description: Defines the CodecOutputBufferRenderer class responsible for rendering CodecOutputBuffer objects to TextureOwner or overlay, including methods for rendering to different buffers and managing buffer lifecycle phases.

classes.name: CodecOutputBufferRenderer
classes.description: A class that manages rendering of CodecOutputBuffer objects to textures or overlays, handling buffer lifecycle and rendering operations.

methods.name: RenderToOverlay
methods.description: Renders the buffer to overlay; returns true if successful.

methods.name: RenderToTextureOwnerFrontBuffer
methods.description: Renders the buffer to the texture owner's front buffer, binding the latest image if needed.

methods.name: RenderToFrontBuffer
methods.description: Renders the buffer to the front buffer of its backing surface.

methods.name: RenderToTextureOwnerBackBuffer
methods.description: Renders the buffer to the back buffer of the texture owner.

methods.name: was_rendered_to_front_buffer
methods.description: Checks if the buffer has been rendered to the front buffer.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the output buffer.

methods.name: color_space
methods.description: Returns the color space of the image.

methods.name: was_tex_image_bound
methods.description: Indicates if the texture image has been bound.

methods.name: texture_owner
methods.description: Returns the TextureOwner associated with the buffer.

methods.name: get_codec_output_buffer_for_testing
methods.description: Returns the underlying CodecOutputBuffer for testing purposes.

methods.name: EnsureBoundIfNeeded
methods.description: Ensures the latest image is bound to the texture if needed.

methods.name: set_phase_for_testing
methods.description: Sets the buffer lifecycle phase for testing.
